newsitem.title: INDIA: India authorises Metdist to raise equity.
newsitem.headline: India authorises Metdist to raise equity.

text.p: India on Thursday authorised copper firm Metdist Industries Ltd to raise 2.9 billion rupees of equity from overseas Indians.

The government said in a statement that the Cabinet Committe of Foreign Investments had approved the Metdist proposal to permit 42.71 percent NRI (non-resident Indian) equity amounting to 2.9 billion rupees on a repatriable basis.
The statement said the company's proposed plant would result in the most modern and up to date transfer of technology and produce good quality copper.
